(()=>{const T=RACE.T,B=T._bx,out=[];for(const m of [6627,13952]){const k0=Math.round(m/T.sp);for(let k=k0-15;k<=k0+3;k++){const x=T.x[k],z=T.z[k];for(const s of B.segs){const dx=s[2]-s[0],dz=s[3]-s[1],L=dx*dx+dz*dz,f=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-s[0])*dx+(z-s[1])*dz)/L)),d=Math.hypot(x-s[0]-f*dx,z-s[1]-f*dz);if(d<T.hw[k]+1.5)out.push(['seg',m,k-k0,+d.toFixed(1),+T.hw[k].toFixed(1),s.map(v=>+v.toFixed(1))])}for(const p of B.pts){const d=Math.hypot(x-p[0],z-p[1]);if(d<T.hw[k]+2)out.push(['pt',m,k-k0,+d.toFixed(1),p])}}}return JSON.stringify(out.slice(0,30))+' rails '+[T.railL[Math.round(6627/T.sp)],T.railR[Math.round(6627/T.sp)],T.hw[Math.round(6627/T.sp)]]})()
